output.headerText:
OR3 DB Storage / Blob Transfer Layer — Security Audit Pack

Scope: Presign upload/download/commit/GC APIs, expiry + quota helpers, gateway storage adapter registry, client transfer queue/leases, local file/attachment Dexie helpers, related docs/tests.

Primary surfaces:
1. server/api/storage/* — presign-upload/download, commit, GC (can()-gated, no-store)
2. server/utils/storage/* — presign expiry caps, quotas, metrics
3. server/storage/gateway — adapter registry/types
4. app/core/storage/* — transfer queue, leases, gateway client provider
5. app/db/files*.ts + attachments — local metadata / ref_count semantics
6. app/plugins/storage-transfer.client.ts — client bootstrap

Note: Concrete FS/S3 upload handlers often live in provider packages (or3-provider-fs / or3-provider-s3). This pack covers the in-repo gateway + API contract those providers plug into.

Excluded: Sync engine (separate), auth engine (separate), AI proxy, themes/plugins/webhooks.
